digest.component_or_area: DC outbound text sanitization and convergence testing
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions, while Cloud has both to prevent infinite re-emission of truncated values
DC's comment sanitizer incorrectly reuses the description fitter (fit_outbound) as both handle the same 32767-character limit but the coupling risks future incompatibility
Test infrastructure must inject the DC backend explicitly through all three seam parameters (outbound_mapper, inbound_mapper, links) to avoid silently falling back to Cloud's backend

The comment convergence test requires identity/recording proof that the injected DC sanitizer actually executed, not value-based assertions, because DC and Cloud truncate at identical limits and append identical suffixes

The 32767-character ceiling for comments is correctly sourced from jira.text.field.character.limit property default (verified via jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519) and must be documented at the binding site to replace assumption with citation
